<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/sites/{siteCode}/structures"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns every FixedStructure registered at a site, ordered by id (ADR-0017).

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
